source_scope.aggregation: all validated contributions weighted by 1 + gate_q

finding.claim: Cells excluded from the selected Hyperposition/GWT coalition can dominate and reverse the emitted Global J-Space vector while the winner and packet role remain unchanged.
finding.risk: The trace can describe one selected winner/role while the actual broadcast direction is dominated by nonselected cells. Training on that packet can therefore teach a control semantics that is not causally aligned with the reported coalition unless all-cell global mixing is made an explicit separate contract.

hypotheses.preferred_contract: The role-relevant emitted packet should aggregate only the admitted GWT/Hyperposition coalition that justifies that role, not unrelated losing cells outside the selection margin.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The packet is intentionally a population-wide global mixture and winner.role is only a target label, not a description of causal contributors.
hypotheses.discriminator_result: Current source behavior supports the population-wide mixture mechanically, but the trace and role labeling do not explicitly bind that stronger semantics. The mechanism is therefore under-specified for training promotion.

repair_candidates.reason: Aligns broadcast contributors with winner/hyperposition selection and preserves explicit alternatives within the admitted margin.
Prevents reversal but discards the intended near-tie Hyperposition contribution.
Keep all-cell mixture only if packet role/trace semantics become explicitly global and every contributing cell is causally bound to admitted GRID/inference evidence.

unusual_experiment_accounting.reason: Retained PR coordination already records the shared go unusual-experiment slot as consumed. Preserve this new counterexample only as zero-credit bounded falsifier evidence rather than claiming a second unusual experiment.

next_exact_gate: On the single retained PR1263 path, adjudicate coalition-only versus explicit-global broadcast semantics, add a deterministic regression that prevents silent out-of-coalition reversal under the selected contract, bind every admitted broadcast contributor to causal GRID/inference evidence when required, then run the exact-current FREE authorized isolated HCU/J-Space regression batch when a callable sandbox execution path exists.
